text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, some time after the Yasuda Kinen 
had ended, Hishi Akebono comes to consult 
you, saying her leg feels strange.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The diagnosis was accumulated fatigue. 
Having constantly supported her large 
frame and the immense strain that came 
with it, her legs were finally reaching 
their limit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thinking ahead, the Trainer proposed a 
running style focused on losing weight and 
reducing strain on her legs.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Hishi Akebono didn't immediately 
agree. Because what everyone was waiting 
for was "a race with a big Hishi Akebono."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to take a good look at the 
audience at the Sprinters Stakes in three 
months before giving her answer. That was 
Hishi Akebono's answer for now.
